messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — saw a perf regression on the qwen-7b int8 AWQ build during long-seq runs (2048). 20-25% token/sec drop vs float baseline. linking profiler: https://perf.internal/runs/1778 :eyes:

mj: ugh, is it KV pressure or a kernel fallback? did the kernel selector flip to a generic path?

alex: looks like kernel fallback. top from perf (summarized):
```
perf top -p 4321
attn_linear_kernel           42.3%
kv_cache_apply               18.9%
quant_dequant                12.1%
other_gemm                   6.7%
memcpy                       4.2%
```

sara: interesting — we changed RoPE scaling to 1.5 for the qwen variant last week. RoPE scaling + odd head_dim can change which GEMM kernels are chosen (alignment mis-match). did the model head_dim change?

alex: head_dim unchanged but heads*head_dim gives per-head stride that is not 64-aligned for this build. selector logic currently prefers fast int8 kernels only when head_dim % 64 == 0. AWQ quantization produced different packing, so selector fell back to slower generic gemm.

ryan: concrete numbers? accuracy vs perf?

sara: I ran a quick micro-eval:
- baseline fp16: ppl=12.1, acc=0.743
- AWQ (calib 200 prompts): ppl=12.5, acc=0.739 (-0.4)
- GPTQ (calib 500): ppl=12.6, acc=0.735 (-0.8)
Perf: fp16 tokens/sec=1000, AWQ tokens/sec=760, GPTQ tokens/sec=690
(note: AWQ had smaller accuracy delta but bigger perf drop than expected)

nidhi: calibration prompts used? could calibration affect packing and kernel picks?

alex: calib files: prompts/calib_200.txt and prompts/calib_500.txt (shared in workspace). AWQ used 200 by default. Ran with:
```
./run_eval --model qwen-7b-awq-int8 --seq 2048 --calib prompts/calib_200.txt --profile
```

mj: deploy-bot just flagged the canary: "canary rollout paused — perf regression > 20%"
deploy-bot: canary paused (action required)

ops: we've already halted traffic to the canary. no customer impact yet.

ryan: quick mitigation options: 1) force kernel selector to prefer aligned AVX int8 kernels even if packing odd (risky), 2) reduce batching window for this model to lower KV memory pressure, 3) re-run AWQ with 500 calib prompts to see if packing improves.

sara: I think (3) + selector tweak is safest: if AWQ with 500 prompts yields similar accuracy and restores kernel pick, do that and then roll selector patch that checks both head_dim alignment and quant packing metadata (we can add an override flag for canary).

alex: I pushed a repro script to infra/tests/qwen_int8_regress.sh and a small selector patch to my branch (alex/kernel-selector-qwen). Need someone to validate on the 8xA100 canary.

nidhi: I'll run the repro on canary tomorrow morning with calib_500 and report numbers. putting a perf CI job on it too: seq=2048, concurrency=8, duration=120s.

mj: action items:
- alex: open PR with selector tests + canary override (ETA end of day)
- nidhi: run 500-calib test on canary + CI job (ETA +12h)
- sara: draft short note on RoPE scaling interactions for the model onboarding doc
- ryan: prepare rollback plan if selector tweak causes accuracy regression

alex: thanks — ping me if you want the profiler link or the raw perf flamegraphs. I'll attach the flamegraph in the PR. :thumbsup:

mj: ack. adding a perf regression alert test to the gate so next canary can't slide through. :lock:

ops: keeping the canary paused until we get the repro.

nidhi: will post results in this thread when done.

alex: short term note for release notes: "Temporarily paused qwen-7b-int8 AWQ canary due to perf regression caused by kernel fallback under specific RoPE/packing conditions. Fix in progress." :gear:

sara: good. also adding a small checklist for future quant onboarding: include head_dim alignment check, RoPE scale sensitivity, calibration prompt sweep.

mj: cool. thanks everyone. (reaction :eyes:)
